description: This file defines an interface INoteRepository that abstracts storage and retrieval operations for notes in the NotesBackend project. It declares asynchronous methods for CRUD operations and retrieval of notes, facilitating dependency injection and testability.

classes.name: INoteRepository
classes.description: Interface for note data operations, including fetching all notes, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all notes asynchronously, with optional cancellation support.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its unique ID asynchronously, with optional cancellation support.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing note asynchronously, returns a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID asynchronously, returns a boolean indicating success.
